notes: *be full* heads on *full* under rule 44; the copula-plus-complement test puts the lexeme on the complement.
`הָאָרֶץ הַטֹּבָה` writes one *the*, which the noun's own article takes while the agreement article on the adjective is unrepresented (rule 47).
The dative `לְ` of natan-lakh is unrepresented under rule 40 and the suffix takes the bare object pronoun *thee*.
